summary: Known build recipe: [build] section in cases/*.toml wired into the run prompt
description:
Source: ANVIL-62 rehearsal-2 analysis — the agent tried 5 `waf configure` variants, 2 failing, before building. A case-declared recipe saves minutes per run and removes a class of failures.

**Fix:** a `[build]` section in `cases/*.toml` (configure, build, test commands for the BSP — TC1: erc32 + SIS, as the CI overlay runs them). The run prompt names it as "the build and test commands for this code base" (a recipe, not a hint about the fix), and the defect-fix skill uses it.

**Acceptance:** a case with `[build]` puts those commands into the agent's task; a case without one changes nothing.

comments.body: [devin] PR #90 up: https://github.com/vishal7pandey/anvil/pull/90 — [build] table in cases/*.toml parsed to Case.build; executor._task_message appends it as 'the build and test commands for this code base'; defect-fix skill points at it; rtems-5776 declares the erc32+SIS recipe. Proven by tests on the real case file and real task builder.
